sentences.en: Dr. Patterson: Oh, no! She was very gentle with him.
sentences.zh: 帕特森医生：哦，不！她对他很温柔。

sentences.en: His eyes are as gentle as those of a cow.
sentences.zh: 他的眼睛像牛的眼睛一样温顺。

sentences.en: He seems rough, but at heart he is very gentle.
sentences.zh: 他看起来粗犷，但内心其实非常温和。

senses.zh: 和蔼的，轻柔的，显赫的，温和的，文雅的，有教养的
使显赫，使温顺，抚摸，使缓和
